We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Platform squads

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product: our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us.

You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on.

Your mission

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Your impact

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

What we're looking for

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate)

  • Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner

title: Tech Lead - Solutions
original_description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico's customers feel one pain above all: missing parts that block delivery. The Solution squads are where we turn Pelico's platform into a product that fixes it. Each squad owns one solution surface — Material Coverage & inventory, Quality, Supplier & customer Collaboration / AI Buyer, MRO & Aftermarket, Program Management, or Strategic Account Support — composing our platform's building blocks into workflows that work across many customers. You'll lead one surface end to end: ship it fast, keep it configuration-first, and feed real customer patterns back into the platform — while our Regional Solution Engineering pods carry the day-to-day customer relationship.

What You'll Do

You'll own a solution surface — and build it yourself:

  • Ship the surface. Compose configuration, compute, widgets, connectors, and agents into customer-facing workflows that pass a real acid test on real customers.

  • Stay configuration-first. Solve in Phoenix YAML wherever you can, reach for code only when it's worth it, and never let the surface fragment into per-customer forks.

  • Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and put eval and review gates on anything AI-assisted that touches a customer.

  • Harvest the field. Spot the patterns that recur across accounts and turn them into platform capabilities, so the next customer is faster.

  • Lead by example. Write the code, pair with your squad and the engineers deploying at customer sites, raise the bar, and grow the team as the impact you ship earns it.

Your impact: Customers buy outcomes — shortages caught, deliveries recovered, quality exceptions resolved. Your squad is where the platform becomes those outcomes. Own a surface well and you make Pelico's revenue engine both faster and more defensible — and you keep it from collapsing into bespoke work that can't scale.

About You

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior full-stack engineer with real product and customer judgment. You're energized by shipping outcomes under real constraints, you decide what not to build, and you lead by being in the code with your team.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing product software end to end, full-stack, under real delivery pressure

  • Strong, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (backend) and TypeScript / React (frontend); strong in one and credible across, or a fast learner

  • Product and customer judgment — scope to outcomes, cut to MVP under deadline, decide what not to build

  • A configuration-first, anti-bespoke instinct — you build for many customers, not one fork at a time

  • A track record of leading engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

Nice to have:

  • Aerospace / defense / supply-chain / discrete-manufacturing context (MRP, BoM, coverage, MRO/TAT, program management, procurement)

  • Forward-deployed / solutions-engineering / customer-embedded experience, feeding learnings back into a platform

  • Configuration- or low-code-driven product experience (YAML/DSL, composable UI, workflow authoring)

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval on AI output, spec-driven development)

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

  • Work at the frontier of applied AI, with exposure to cutting-edge AI tooling and operational challenges inside a high-growth startup

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min)

  3. Case Study Onsite 1h30 / 2h

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. References, run in parallel

We move fast and we're transparent at every step.

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

title: Residential Architect
original_description:
TLDR; Davis is looking for a residential specialist, excellent in plan and in drawing, who wants to practice the craft differently than in an agency. We expect around three to four years of experience.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The role

This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. It is not a conventional architect role. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the quality and architectural credibility of our deliverables, now generated in hours; co-producing the architectural plans that go with them; and actively contributing to the development of our plan-generation technology. It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond your own output.

You will run a portfolio of residential projects, under the supervision of a lead architect, from feasibility through to schematic design.

The core of the role

  • Read the local planning documents (zoning plans, development-orientation schemes, easements) and derive the project assumptions from them.

  • Develop massing, circulation principles and capacity scenarios consistent with the regulatory framework.

  • Certify the architectural credibility of what the pipeline produces, confirming that each plan is sound and setting out the reasoning behind it.

  • Develop the project phase after phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design.

  • Produce the graphic documents (plans, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling.

  • Arbitrate between scenarios against programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize best practice, translating what a strong residential plan respects into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, defining the standard a strong plan meets and validating each result against it, with the reasoning.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: around 3 to 4 years in an agency, ideally one specialized in residential work. You have a real command of the residential floor plan and can, from a site and a brief, produce credible, well-drawn capacity scenarios.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients are real estate developers, whose demands are first about speed and efficiency. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Command of the residential floor plan, circulation, orientation, building depths, cores, the unit-type mix from studio to four-bedroom, tenure types (market-rate, social, intermediate, and affordable home-ownership).

  • Command of the planning documents and how they apply, massing envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, permeable ground, parking, land-use categories.

  • From rule to impact, linking a rule to its concrete effect on a plan or a buildable capacity.

  • Project phases, a solid grasp of the phases from feasibility to schematic design, and what each one implies in level of detail.

  • Graphic production, images and diagrams that explain the project and make it legible.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

Why Join Davis?

  • Work on a real transformation of the real estate profession and co-build a next-generation feasibility standard with a high-caliber technical team.

  • Have a direct, visible impact on every deliverable and take part in the continuous progress of the technology.

  • Be exposed to a rare volume and diversity of projects.

  • Join a driven, ambitious team, in a young, growing company where the methods and the tools are still being built and where your expertise truly counts. Enough to learn fast and shape the way we work.

Package

  • Full-time fixed-term contract, with the possibility of moving to permanent

  • Competitive compensation based on profile

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
original_description:
What we’re building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer
original_description:
Our Mission

Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results.

At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment.

We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral, we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance.

Prose & Singular in Numbers

  • Founded in 2017, with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles

  • 10M+ consultations completed

  • 2M customers and 350K active subscribers

  • 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas

  • 350+ team members across disciplines

  • $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024

  • Profitable since 2024

Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here

Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here

Position Summary

Prose is seeking a Senior Full-stack Engineer to design, build, and ship the systems behind Singular, our proprietary platform. You'll be part of our Tech organization that designs, builds, and delivers both platform capabilities and product features that power Prose's personalized beauty experience — from the consultation and e-commerce journey to the manufacturing systems that turn every order into a physical, made-to-order product in our NYC and LA facilities.

We are a deliberately compact, senior engineering team. Every engineer owns a broad scope, ships to production continuously, and works with AI-augmented development practices as a core part of the craft. You'll join at a moment where we're evolving toward a modular architecture with clearly separated domains, and you'll have a real voice in those design decisions.

Few engineering teams get to ship code that ends as a physical product formulated for one specific person. If you're passionate about end-to-end ownership, technical excellence, and building with the best AI tooling available, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build & Ship

    • Design, build, and ship features end to end across our stack: Python/Django services and REST APIs on the backend, React applications on the frontend.

    • Own quality on your scope: automated testing, peer review, observability, and production monitoring.

    • Identify and address areas of technical debt, implementing improvements to enhance system performance and maintainability.

  • Architecture & Technical Direction

    • Contribute to our architecture evolution: domain boundaries, data schemas, event-driven patterns, and the tradeoffs of a platform serving both e-commerce and manufacturing.

    • Participate in architecture discussions and system design decisions.

    • Advance our AI implementation across the tech org: make AI-augmented development part of your daily practice, and help shape our agents, skills, and internal tooling rather than just consuming them.

  • Collaboration & Impact

    • Collaborate closely with product, design, data, and operations stakeholders to deliver high-quality features — our scope touches everything from checkout conversion to factory throughput.

    • Bring visibility to ongoing work, risks, and dependencies.

    • Mentor other engineers and raise the team's bar through design and code review.

    • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing across the team.

Key Candidate Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time on both backend and frontend in production systems.

  • Strong backend experience with Python, along with common libraries such as Django, Rest Framework, FastAPI.

  • Solid modern frontend experience with React and the current JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem.

  • Deep understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable application.

  • A knack for writing clean, readable, and maintainable code.

  • Hands-on AI fluency and a genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Comfortable with cloud-native environments: GCP, Docker, CI/CD.

  • Pragmatic mindset, knowing when to invest in perfection, and when to build a PoC.

  • Autonomous on your scope: you own outcomes, escalate when needed, and don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Prior experience in B2C, e-commerce, manufacturing is a plus.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Compensation & Benefits

Prose fosters inclusivity, learning, and diversity within our teams and workplace. Just as we celebrate unique beauty, every team member is encouraged to show up as their full self. In addition to creating an environment where all individuals feel welcome, we offer benefits that include:

💵 Compensation

  • Competitive base salary — 60.000–70.000€ based on experience

  • Variable bonus up to 10% based on company and individual performance

  • BSPCE program

🩺 Health & Wellness

  • 100% coverage of health insurance and life/disability plan (including dependents)

  • Access to CSE allowance

🍽️ Lifestyle & Perks

  • Standard French benefits: Swile meal vouchers, transport allowance, and Syntec vacation bonus

  • €150 worth of personalized Prose products each month

Hiring Process

🕓 Timeline

From first contact to final decision: ~3 weeks

Recruiter Screen — (30–45 min, remote) A first conversation with our dedicated recruiter. He'll walk you through the role, Prose's context, and assess your background and motivations.

Engineering Interview — 1 hour (on-site) Meet an Engineering leader from the team. We'll walk you through the Tech vision, ongoing initiatives, and how the team works day to day — and dig into your experience and technical background.

Live Case — 1 hour 30 (on-site) A practical exercise conducted live with the team — no take-home assignment. We'll walk through a real-world design and coding challenge from our environment. We'll be looking at your methodology, your reasoning, and your ability to stay crisp under realistic conditions.

HR Interview — 1 hour (on-site) A conversation with Sabrina Gavois, VP People & Culture. We'll explore your mindset, values, and cultural fit with Prose.

CTO Interview — 45 min A final conversation with Nicolas Valençot, Chief Technology Officer, on system thinking, ownership, and long-term technical vision.

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

  • We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

  • We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

  • Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication.

  • We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

  • We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead.

  • We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

  • We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

  • We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

Compensation: €60K – €70K • Offers Bonus

  • • €60K – €70K • Offers Bonus

title: AI Engineer Intern
original_description:
TLDR; Davis AI is looking for an AI Engineer Intern to help solve one of the hardest problems in applied AI: building multi-agent systems that remain reliable across long, complex real-estate workflows. You will work on the core delivery pipeline - from context assembly and tool orchestration to verification, storage, evaluation, and observability.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, and more.

You will:

  • Own one delivery pipeline end to end: market, financial, or regulatory analysis.

  • Build the harness around the model: context engineering, tool orchestration, verification, report generation.

  • Build the tools agents rely on: open data (cadastre, zoning, transactions, demographics), extraction from regulatory PDFs and plans etc.

  • Turn every expert correction into source memory, gold datasets and regression evals.

  • Extend the eval harness: LLM judges, replay caches, traces, prompt optimization.

  • Ship production-grade quality and reliability on every output a client receives.

  • Sit with clients and domain experts, challenge your assumptions, and learn how real estate decisions are actually made.

You'll fit right in if you:

  • Write strong backend Python: clean & scalable architecture, typing, async, real tests.

  • Build thin, well-tested harness layers around LLM programs rather than stacking frameworks.

  • Read and write French: our sources and deliverables are in French.

  • Can sit with an architect and work out what "correct" means.

A big plus:

  • Built or evaluated LLM agents in real systems; (DSPy or GEPA for ex).

  • Operated long-running, cost-controlled LLM pipelines: caching, replay, retries, spend tracking, observability.

  • GIS: shapely, projections, parcels and zoning layers, open data.

  • Computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Document understanding: PDF parsing, OCR, layout detection, plan vectorization.

  • Databases and data modeling with versioning.

  • Multi-country products: heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules.

  • Interest in real estate, architecture or urban planning.

Why Davis

  • Build what no one has before: the system that delivers feasibility, investment analysis and design end to end

  • Accelerate your craft: learn from an exceptional team while taking real ownership from day one

  • Meaningful challenges: reliable agents over messy real-world data, deployed on major construction projects

  • Competitive salary

  • Ship fast: prototype to production in weeks, not years

  • A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers and architects, backed by world-class VCs

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why we'll win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

title: Data Center Architect
original_description:
TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has already run data center feasibility studies on their own, and who can answer the question a client asks in front of a site: how many megawatts can this land absorb. We expect three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen end to end.


About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

The data center market is structuring fast, operators and landowners are hunting for sites, and the question they ask is one of capacity: how many megawatts of IT load does this land carry, under what scheme, and on what conditions. We answer in days where the market takes weeks. You will be the person who answers for that number.

You will run a portfolio of test fits and data center feasibility studies, with occasional work on large logistics and industry. Under the supervision of a lead architect, you take these projects from first capacity through to schematic design, and you present them to the client.

The core of the role

  • Establish a site's capacity in IT megawatts, working from the local zoning rules and operating constraints, and set out the assumptions behind it.

  • Qualify the applicable land-use category and the environmental-classification regime for industrial facilities, and derive from them the permitted height, the setbacks and the siting conditions.

  • Draw the data halls at their real grid, fully laid out, with their aisles, their air-handling units and their structural grid.

  • Compose the industrial site plan: service yards, a perimeter heavy-vehicle road, loading docks, retention basins, planted buffers, access and parking.

  • Arbitrate between schemes, one level, two levels or more, while respecting the slab-to-slab height and the zoning height cap.

  • Name the questions to put to the operator: cooling system, density per rack, electrical redundancy, hall dimensions, height.

  • Carry your number in front of the client, and defend it under challenge.

  • Place the project on its critical path: grid connection, environmental permitting, ecological surveys, preventive archaeology.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize data center best practice, translating the sizing cascade, the grids and the thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, saying what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: we count projects as much as years. Three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen across their full cycle. One of them should be a project you carried yourself, from capacity through to permit or schematic design. A background in large logistics or industrial buildings is a valid base, provided you add that data center experience to it.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Product knowledge, the sizing cascade of a data center, hall, power, cooling, telecom and logistics, the slab-to-slab height and what it imposes, the rack-and-aisle grid, electrical redundancy, the order of magnitude of a PUE.

  • Applied regulatory fluency, the land-use sub-category and the 2023 ruling that reclassified data centers, the environmental-classification headings and the threshold that triggers a full environmental permit, height and setback rules, no-net-land-take targets and designation as a project of major national interest, rooftop renewable-energy requirements.

  • Buildable capacity, linking a rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to an installable power.

  • Industrial site planning, heavy-vehicle access, turning circles, fire safety, water management, insertion and edges.

  • Graphic production, plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity argument legible to an investor.

  • Ownership of the subject, presenting, arguing and defending a number in front of a client who contests it. We are looking for someone who has owned the subject end to end, assumptions, number and client presentation.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

  • A command of technical English, the vocabulary of the sector being largely English-speaking.

Why Join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • You will set Davis's data center method, and it will serve every project that follows.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company, where the methods and the tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

  • Fixed-term or permanent depending on the case, to discuss together

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Software Engineer JVM
original_description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

This role focuses on building performant, maintainable systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features that meet business and customer needs. You'll lead development of Pelico's ETL backend in Java, owning scalability and performance for the systems that turn complex, high-volume manufacturing data into a single live operational picture.

Your mission

  • Design, develop, and optimize Pelico's ETL backend components in Java, building scalable and efficient solutions for complex data processing

  • Architect scalable, modular services while ensuring data integrity, security, and availability across distributed environments

  • Integrate third-party services and APIs to extend platform capabilities, and collaborate with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies

  • Develop solutions for large-scale data ingestion, processing, and analysis, optimizing relational database interactions and distributed data systems

  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions, leading by example on Java best practices

  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code and drive unit, integration, and performance testing to guarantee system stability

What we're looking for

  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin (backend), with experience in relational databases and API development

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts and performance optimization techniques

  • Strong grasp of software design principles (SOLID, separation of concerns, DRY) and design patterns, with the ability to write maintainable, testable code

  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, and the ability to define and document technical specifications, balancing feature development with technical debt

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to design robust, scalable solutions and identify and mitigate risk

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

  • (Nice-to-have) Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to junior engineers

  • (Nice-to-have) Experience in manufacturing, aerospace & defense, or industrial sectors is a strong plus

What we offer

  • A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up

  • Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale

  • An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun

  • Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager conversation with the Engineering Manager (45 min)

  3. Case Study onsite 1h30 / 2h

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
original_description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
original_description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build deployment platforms that work everywhere. Design and improve Pelico's deployment architecture across Kubernetes, Docker, single VM, air-gapped environments and private cloud using Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Create a true one-click deployment experience. Standardize installation, upgrades and operational tooling so enterprise customers can deploy Pelico reliably with minimal manual intervention.

  • Improve platform reliability and observability. Build monitoring, diagnostics, self-remediation capabilities and operational runbooks that allow customer IT teams to operate Pelico independently.

  • Participate in production operations. Join the team's on-call rotation, troubleshoot production incidents, and continuously improve platform reliability through operational excellence and automation.

  • Elevate our DevOps platform. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure practices and deployment workflows to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability across the company.

  • Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth. Contribute to initiatives around GovCloud, FedRAMP readiness and deployments for highly regulated aerospace and defense customers.

  • Drive AI-powered infrastructure engineering. Explore agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment, diagnostics and security.

 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments.

  • Strong experience building and operating cloud and on-premise infrastructure using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices.

  • Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset.

  • Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product and customer IT teams.

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work, curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows for coding, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting or engineering productivity.

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting enterprise or industrial environments (manufacturing, aerospace, defense or supply chain).

  • Exposure to security, compliance or regulated infrastructure environments (e.g. GovCloud, FedRAMP or air-gapped deployments).

  • Experience in customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering roles.

 

What we offer

  • Work on a highly impactful product that users love!

  • Office locations: In the heart of Paris (75011) and Miami, USA.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Performance Marketing
original_description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 


Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games and consumer apps.

 

Role

Voodoo is looking for a Lead Software Engineer for our Playable Ads team as part of our Central Growth Team. In this role, you'll lead key initiatives developed by our playable ads team, while staying hands-on with production and driving innovation in our playable ad formats across games.

 

Key tasks

  • Lead and coach a small team of playable ads developers/strategists embedded within franchise-dedicated squads, ensuring high autonomy and strong performance

  • Stay hands-on with playable ad production, contributing directly to the creation and iteration of high-quality playable creatives

  • Oversee operational topics for the playable team, including workflows, tooling, and best practices

  • Drive innovation in playable ad formats, constantly exploring new mechanics, interactions, and creative concepts to stay ahead of market trends

  • Collaborate closely with the Growth Manager and creative strategists to align on priorities and franchise-level objectives

  • Benchmark competitor playable ads and analyze performance data to improve production quality and effectiveness

  • Act as a technical and/or strategic reference for the team, providing guidance on both development and marketing performance topics

  • Support the rollout of playable ads across multiple game franchises, adapting formats to each title's creative strategy

  • Contribute to defining and evolving the playable ads chapter's vision, standards, and processes


Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in playable ad or game development

  • Hands-on, maker mindset - you're comfortable getting into production yourself while also stepping back to coordinate

  • Experience with relevant playable ads development tools or frameworks Unity (Luna), Cocos Creator or other relevant platforms

  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming and web game development

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and asset generation (Scenario, Flux, ElevenLabs)

  • Solid understanding of mobile marketing performance metrics and creative testing

  • Proven ability to mentor and coach peers

  • You have entrepreneurial mindset and can adapt to a high-paced environment

  • You can demonstrate excellent teamwork and collaboration skills

  • You are fluent in English (fluency in French is a plus)

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience

  • Swile restaurant lunch voucher

  • Gymlib sports subscription (100% taken in charge by us)

  • Sidecare healthcare coverage for your family

  • Child day care facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouge)

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Creative hackathon

  • Unlimited vacation policy

  • Full stack desk and computer equipment upon your request

  • Cooperate within a globally diverse team and a rich cross-cultural work environment

title: Software Engineer - Performance Marketing
original_description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000+ employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Paper.io, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Growth team helps maximize the potential of each Voodoo product within the ecosystem. Our Growth team is split across several areas of expertise, such as user acquisition, ad monetization, video ads, playable ads, and influencer marketers. Being part of the Growth Team at Voodoo requires strong operational excellence and creativity in order to constantly adapt and stay ahead of the market.

The core mission of the Playable Ads team is to create engaging and interactive advertising experiences that captivate audiences and drive conversions. We work with playable developers and coordinators that turn a game into an HTML interactive ad experience. Your main mission will be to produce high-performing ads by creating and uploading them to our various ad networks.

Role

We are looking for talented individuals interested in creating playable ads that let users try our games! To succeed in this role, you need extensive Unity development experience with a past of creating unique user experiences for a global audience. You will be converting existing games into playable ads and collaborating on the creation of tools for other interactive ad formats.

  • Transform existing games into interactive user experiences

  • Optimize playable ads for the best user experience, scalability, and adaptability

  • Integrate an analytics solution to measure interactions and gain insights to offer the best user experience

  • Build interactive playable templates that can be customized by graphic designers

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives (e.g. testing new tools, implementing new processes, etc.)

  • Develop a deep understanding of how your creations perform and why

  • Work within a small creative squad with amazing people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities

  • Have the opportunity to cover different product scopes (e.g., hypercasual, casual, consumer apps, etc.)

  • Become a creative expert in mobile gaming: benchmark what our competitors are doing, experiment with new ideas

Profile

  • Fully proficient in playable ad creation or in developing Unity projects (size optimized to be used as playable)

  • Experience creating playable ads in Unity (Luna), Cocos Creator or any relevant platform

  • Adequate knowledge of object-oriented programming and web game development

  • Proactive problem diagnosis and creative problem-solving skills

  • Fluent in English, both oral and written

  • 3+ years of experience in a similar role

  • Deeply familiar with the mobile gaming market, in particular, hyper casual and casual games

  • Creative mindset and knowledge in game design

  • Familiarity with 3rd party SDKs, analytics, and A/B testing in mobile games (preferred but not essential)

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and asset generation (Scenario, Flux, ElevenLabs)

Benefits

Competitive salary and other benefits according to the country you reside in.

Full remote for candidates based abroad, with relocation to Paris subject to discussion. Hybrid for candidates based in France.

title: Senior Security Engineer
original_description:
Centreon cherche à renforcer l'équipe sécurité en intégrant un senior security engineer. Au cœur du produit Centreon, la team security a un impact fort. Elle joue un rôle central au sein de la R&D composée d’environ 50 tech. Elle collabore notamment étroitement avec les équipes  infra cloud et software engineers.

Pluridisciplinaire, vous intégrez une équipe composée de 2 personnes au profils riches et variés. Vous êtes expert sur la partie Cloud et notamment AWS. Vous accompagnerez l’ensemble de la tech (dev, product, SRE) pour apporter les best practices, construire la plateforme, automatiser  les process, déployer des composants, opérer des solutions etc 

Vos missions seront diverses et  toujours guidées par l’envie de partager les succès mais avec un ownership fort.

Missions : 

  • Intégrer les pratiques de sécurité dans le cycle complet de notre infrastructure et de notre plateforme cloud en interne ainsi que dans nos produits SaaS.

  • Contribuer au développement d'une architecture de sécurité robuste qui s'aligne sur le modèle zéro trust.

  • Renforcer la sécurité du cloud (AWS, on-prem), participer au hardening de l’infra, à la protection contre les menaces avancées et à la conception de SaaS sécurisés.

  • Participer activement à une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE.

  • Construire et opérer la stratégie de sécurisation des usages et technologies d'IA au sein de l'entreprise;

  • Garantir la maintenabilité et l'évolutivité des différents composants, en diffusant les best practices de sécurité à l'état de l'art ;

  • Collaborer avec les software engineers, l'équipe infra et le produit pour construire des produits et des services secure by design ;

  • Construire une stratégie de réponse aux incidents efficace et solide à l’aide de systèmes d'alerting  et de détection modernes ; corriger et mitiger les problèmes de sécurité en collaboration avec l'équipe Infra..

  • Faire évoluer les capacités de l'équipe sécurité en s'appuyant sur l'IA agentique pour automatiser le traitement des tâches répétitives (alertes, triage, reporting)

  • Être un membre actif de la guilde de sécurité

  • Bug Bounty management

Stack technique : AWS – Terraform – Zero trust : Okta, Teleport  - SSLDC - SIEM 


Profil et compétences 

  • Vous êtes autonome et faites preuve d’ownership, êtes capable de leader des projet transverses

  • Vous avez une expérience significative en sécurité des infra cloud : système, réseau et notamment AWS.

  • Vous avez une bonne compréhension de la sécurité dans les systèmes distribués à l'échelle..

  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la gestion de l'IAM sur les fournisseurs de cloud (AWS, Auth0).

  • Vous maîtrisez un ou plusieurs langages de notre stack tech.

  • Vous avez un intérêt pour l'écosystème OpenSource et pour le monitoring.

  • Vous aimez innover et faire évoluer les architectures des plateformes vers une plus grande scalabilité.

  • Vous voulez être un membre actif d'une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE.


Les plus qui feront la différence :

  • Vous avez des compétences ou expériences et intérêt pour la sécurité corporate IT  (SSO/IAM, EDR, MDM...)

  • Vous êtes sensible à la culture de l’open-source 

  • Vous êtes sensible à l’expérience utilisateur (performance, ergonomie, utilisabilité, etc.) 

  • Vous aimez défier vos collègues au babyfoot ! 

Ce que nous offrons

  • Société en forte croissance (+20%  en 2025) dans un environnement international

  • Venez apprécier nos locaux à Paris avec terrasse à Olympiade - Métro ligne 14 ou à Toulouse quartier Compans Caffarelli (immeubles accessibles PMR)

  • RTT et Carte Tickets restaurant

  • Events mensuels et semestriels

  • Petits dej mensuels

  • Un programme d'Onboarding

Nous avons à cœur de mettre en avant la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, de nationalité ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi dans le pays où le candidat postule.
