title: Software & Hardware Integration QA Engineer
original_description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

Your role

Your Role

As a Software & Hardware Integration QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Quandela’s quantum computing systems.

Your main focus will be on validating the integration between software and physical hardware: ensuring that our software interfaces correctly control, communicate with, and monitor equipment such as photon sources, laser control systems and other optical and electronic components.

You will design and automate integration and end-to-end testing, while helping structure robust validation processes as Quandela moves from low-volume, highly complex systems toward more scalable and repeatable production.

Working closely with software, hardware, systems and industrialization teams, you will contribute to building the testing methods, tools, documentation and quality standards required for this next stage of growth.

Your Key Responsibilities 

  • Define QA plans, test strategies, acceptance criteria and validation procedures for software/hardware integrated systems.
  • Design and execute functional, integration, system, regression and robustness tests on real equipment.
  • Build automated software-to-hardware integration and end-to-end tests.
  • Validate complete workflows, from software interfaces and commands to their execution by physical equipment.
  • Test and troubleshoot communication between software and hardware through interfaces and protocols such as Ethernet and serial connections.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests and test tools using Python and testing frameworks such as Behave, with reporting tools such as Allure.
  • Integrate automated testing into continuous integration pipelines where relevant.
  • Reproduce, document and track defects through resolution, verify fixes and assess regression risks.
  • Maintain clear traceability between requirements, test cases, defects and test results.
  • Produce test reports, quality metrics and technical documentation to support validation and release decisions.
  • Help define and continuously improve industrial-grade validation processes, test procedures and quality practices.
  • Build reusable and scalable testing methods to support the progressive ramp-up of Quandela’s quantum computing systems.
  • Collaborate closely with software, hardware, systems and industrialization engineers to improve overall product quality.

Requirements

  • Around 5 years of experience in software QA, system validation, verification & validation, test engineering or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience testing systems combining software and hardware.
  • Strong experience with test automation and scripting, ideally using Python.
  • Ability to understand, test and troubleshoot hardware/software interactions and communication protocols.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and reporting tools; experience with Behave and/or Allure is a plus.
  • Experience working within structured software development and QA processes, including requirements traceability, documented testing, defect management and release validation.
  • An interest in building and improving testing processes, rather than only executing existing test plans.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to produce clear and structured technical documentation.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Experience in industrial environments such as robotics, embedded systems, scientific instrumentation, photonics, semiconductor equipment, medical devices, automotive, aerospace or other complex hardware/software systems would be particularly relevant.

Knowledge of quality standards such as IEC 61508 or ISO 9001 would be appreciated but is not mandatory.

An engineering degree or equivalent technical background is welcome, but we value relevant hands-on experience and demonstrated technical skills above all.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
original_description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

Your role

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will contribute to the infrastructure powering Quandela's cloud and software platforms.

Working closely with our software and infrastructure teams, you will design, deploy and operate our infrastructure across multiple cloud environments, with a strong focus on Infrastructure as Code, automation, reliability and scalability.

You will contribute both to day-to-day operations and to the continuous evolution of our cloud architecture and DevOps practices.

Your Key Responsibilities 

    • Design, deploy and maintain robust, scalable and secure infrastructure across multiple cloud environments.
    • Provision and manage cloud infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code, primarily using Terraform.
    • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting our applications and services.
    • Deploy and operate containerized workloads using Docker/Podman and Kubernetes.
    • Automate infrastructure configuration and operational tasks using tools such as Ansible, Python and Bash.
    • Monitor infrastructure and applications to ensure availability, reliability and performance.
    • Implement networking and security best practices across cloud environments.
    • Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment and application issues in collaboration with development teams.
    • Improve observability, automation and operational processes.
    • Optimize infrastructure usage and cloud resources.
    • Contribute to architectural decisions and the continuous improvement of our cloud platform.

Requirements

You have hands-on experience as a Cloud, DevOps, Platform or Infrastructure Engineer, with a strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and automation.

You are comfortable managing infrastructure through code and working across cloud, containers, networking and software deployment.

You bring experience with:

  • Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Cloud infrastructure and cloud providers.
  • Linux environments and system administration.
  • Containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Podman and Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD environments, ideally GitLab CI/CD.
  • Configuration management tools such as Ansible.
  • Scripting and automation with Python and/or Bash.
  • Networking and security principles in cloud environments.
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting and operating production infrastructure.

Experience with OpenStack would be a plus.

You are comfortable working in English and enjoy collaborating with international and multidisciplinary teams.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
  • Previous professional experience, ideally 3+ years of experience in Cloud, DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE or a related infrastructure role.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

title: HIL Engineer — Huracan Rocket Engine
original_description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

 

About the role

The Exploration Company is developing Huracan, a cryogenic rocket engine. The engine integrates e-pumps, power electronics, valves, embedded software, and control systems. We are seeking a Hardware-in-the-Loop Engineer to develop and operate HIL platforms for verifying the ECU, PDU, Valve Controller, inverter, electric pumps, and associated software. You will connect real hardware to real-time simulations, automate testing and data analysis, and develop emulator hardware for sensors, actuators, interfaces, and subsystem behaviour.

You will verify nominal and fault conditions while ensuring test repeatability, traceability, and early fault detection. You will work closely with propulsion, embedded-software, power-electronics, control-systems, and hardware engineers to validate Huracan from simulation through laboratory testing.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain the HIL test environment for our engine propulsion system, from engine controller board level up to the integrated propulsion subsystem

  • Define and implement the hardware and software architecture of the propulsion HIL bench, including signal conditioning, load and fault-insertion hardware, and real-time targets

  • Integrate real-time plant models (e.g., feed system, valves, pumps and motors, combustion chamber, thermal behaviour) into NI VeriStand and close the loop with the engine control unit

  • Emulate and simulate the sensors the controller depends on (e.g., pressure transducers, thermocouples and RTDs, flow meters, position and speed feedback) with flight-representative electrical characteristics

  • Emulate or integrate actuators and power electronics, such as valve drivers, motor inverters, igniters, and their control units, as real hardware, electrical loads, or models

  • Develop LabVIEW-based applications for desktop and real-time platforms (e.g., PXI, cRIO), including custom devices and bus interfaces (e.g., CAN, RS-422/485, Ethernet)

  • Implement fault injection at the electrical and model level to verify engine start-up, shutdown, and abort sequences as well as FDIR behaviour

  • Support test execution, data acquisition, logging, and automated reporting during verification campaigns

  • Validate and correlate simulation models against component-level and engine test data together with the propulsion team

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture specifications, interface definitions, model and code documentation, and user guides

  • Debug and troubleshoot across the bench, the models, and the unit under test, and continuously improve the test platform

You will be in charge of

  • Delivering a robust and scalable HIL platform whose models, I/O configuration, and test sequences can be reused across engine configurations and projects

  • Running control loops and plant models deterministically at the rates the engine controller requires, using NI hardware, LabVIEW RT, and FPGA where timing demands it

  • Defining test automation workflows using NI TestStand and integrating them into the propulsion and system-level verification process

  • Coordinating closely with propulsion, avionics, and flight software engineers to ensure requirements traceability and test coverage

  • Keeping models, bench hardware, and test software under configuration control so that every test run is reproducible

  • Contributing to the continuous evolution of our HiL infrastructure, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Ensuring all solutions meet space-grade quality and safety standards, aligned with project requirements

Must-Have Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience building and operating HIL test benches for closed-loop control systems (e.g., engine, motor, or actuator controllers)

  • Proficiency in LabVIEW, including desktop and real-time application development

  • Hands-on experience with NI VeriStand in real-time test environments, including integration of simulation models (e.g., Simulink, FMU, or C/C++)

  • Experience emulating sensors and actuators at the electrical level (e.g., analog, thermocouple/RTD, frequency and PWM, discrete I/O) and working with motor drives or inverters

  • Familiarity with NI TestStand for test automation and execution management

  • Solid understanding of test platform architectures, hardware/software integration, and real-time systems

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with a structured and methodical approach

  • Ability to write and integrate Python scripts to extend test workflows or support automation tasks

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with LabVIEW FPGA, for example for high-speed sensor emulation or motor and inverter simulation

  • Background in liquid rocket propulsion or in fluid and thermal system modelling

  • Experience with fault-insertion hardware and FDIR verification

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards or equivalent aerospace standards such as DO-178C

  • Experience supporting engine or integrated system test campaigns

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Research Engineer, Sandboxes
original_description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Research Software Engineer on the Sandboxes team, you will design, build, and operate the platform that runs isolated environments for untrusted code at massive scale. Our work spans distributed systems, low-level virtualization, and product-minded platform design. Engineers on this team move between deep infrastructure work and understanding how researchers actually use the platform.

This is a software engineering role, not an ML research role. You do not need prior ML experience; what matters is writing clean, reliable systems code that scales. You will join a small, senior team where the wrong hire is worse than no hire.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and operate the sandboxing platform that runs untrusted code at scale across multiple Kubernetes clusters, from our own bare metal data centers to hyperscalers.

  • Develop the sandbox runtime leveraging Firecracker, enabling fast startup, snapshotting, and efficient scheduling without blocking expensive hardware.

  • Obsess over performance and latency optimisation allowing us to reach millions of concurrent sandboxes.

  • Write robust, well-tested systems code in Rust and Python; review code, CI/CD, and observability across the platform.

  • Own cross-cluster networking, security boundaries, isolation guarantees and monitoring for suspicious activity.

  • Collaborate with researchers and ML engineers who use sandboxes for synthetic data generation and RL training, turning their needs into platform features.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong background in software engineering and distributed systems, with experience building and operating large-scale infrastructure.

  • Deep expertise in at least one of: Kubernetes and cluster operations, cross-cluster networking, observability, or low-level virtualization.

  • Fluency in Python or Rust; comfortable writing systems code where performance and security matter.

  • Strong software-design instincts: modular code, testing, CI/CD, observability, and a bias for reliability.

  • A self-starter who learns fast. Core skills matter more than specific tools — we value meta-learning ability and motivation highly.

  • Low-ego, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity in a small, high-ownership team.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Firecracker, microVMs, or similar virtualization technologies.

  • Product-mindedness: understanding of how sandboxes are used for synthetic data generation or RL training.

  • Experience with GPU clusters, CUDA, or ML workloads.

  • Prior SRE or platform engineering experience at scale.

  • Open-source contributions or widely used internal tools.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Research Engineer, Orchestral
original_description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

As a Research Engineer on the Orchestral team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. Orchestral is the system our researchers rely on to run training and evaluation at scale — from the rollout engine that powers agentic workflows to the infrastructure that keeps their workloads running reliably. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on.

Your work will span the platform's core: the library, tooling, abstractions and rollout engine — including new capabilities like long-running tasks, subagents and RL features — and the machinery that runs data and jobs at scale, with a focus on resiliency, routing and request handling. You will own significant pieces end to end, from design to production.

This is a software engineering role rather than an ML or infrastructure-operations one: RL or PyTorch experience is not required, and you will spend your time building the platform, not operating it. You will be building a distributed RL system, with the scientists as your users.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models.

  • Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long-running tasks and subagents.

  • Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale.

  • Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling.

  • Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation.

  • Contribute to open-source rollout-engine and agent-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience directly building and debugging complex distributed systems at scale, with an emphasis on reliability and scalability.

  • Strong Python skills and solid software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • A builder mindset: you have constructed systems from the ground up, not just operated polished ones.

  • A track record in small teams running complex systems at scale — for example in finance, crypto or ad tech.

  • Self-starter, low-ego and collaborative, with a product mindset toward your users.

  • Curiosity about ML and RL — this experience is not required, but a desire to learn is.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on experience with Ray or similar distributed-computing frameworks.

  • Open-source contributions, especially to rollout-engine or agent-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL.

  • Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Head of Engineering
original_description:
Des centaines de GPU NVIDIA dernière génération, des clusters à multiplier, des sites à ouvrir : Arkane Cloud cherche son Head of Infrastructure pour porter la croissance d’un cloud GPU français et souverain.

 

Arkane Cloud

 

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique :

 

  • Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler.

  • Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes.

 

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

 

Pourquoi ce poste ?

 

Spécialisé dans l’IA-as-a-Service et GPU-as-a-Service, nous avons une infrastructure allant d'A5000 jusqu’au NVIDIA HGX B300 (InfiniBand XDR, stockage VAST Data). Nous créons ce poste pour nous accompagner dans les futurs déploiements, puis multiplier les clusters et les sites, avec une équipe qui grandit en parallèle.

 

C’est un poste de bâtisseur : vous êtes responsable de l’infrastructure de bout en bout, de la commande du matériel au GPU disponible pour le client.

 

Vos missions

 

  • Concevoir et déployer les clusters GPU (HGX B300, GB300, Vera Rubin) selon les référence architectures NVIDIA.

  • Porter le réseau et le stockage : InfiniBand XDR, RoCE v2, connectivité externe, VAST Data.

  • Choisir et négocier data centers et fournisseurs : colocation, énergie, refroidissement liquide, NVIDIA, OEM, intégrateurs.

  • Tenir le SLA : supervision, astreinte, incidents, automatisation, volet infrastructure d’ISO 27001 puis SecNumCloud.

  • Construire et manager l’équipe infrastructure et DevOps, et piloter le TCO et le revenu par GPU.

 

Vos 6 premiers mois

 

1er mois : le cluster HGX B300 est en production, recetté et conforme à la référence architecture NVIDIA.

3 mois : astreinte et process d’incident en place, plan de capacité à 12 mois validé, contrats fournisseurs clés sécurisés.

6 mois : nouveau cluster ou site déployé dans les délais et le budget, SLA tenu et mesuré, recrutements clés réalisés, ISO 27001 prête pour l’audit côté infrastructure.

 

Votre expérience

 

  • 10 ans ou plus en infrastructure, dont 3 ans au moins à la tête d’une équipe infrastructure GPU.

  • Au moins un cluster de plusieurs centaines de GPU NVIDIA (HGX) livré en personne

 

Vos expertises

 

  • Réseaux haute performance : InfiniBand ou RoCE v2 (rail-optimized, fat-tree, gestion de fabric).

  • Data center : colocation, contraintes électriques et thermiques, refroidissement liquide ou plus de 120 kW par baie.

  • Négociation de contrats matériel et colocation.

  • Exploitation en production : SLA, astreinte, gestion d’incidents.

  • Anglais professionnel courant.

 

Un vrai plus :

 

  • Expérience chez un cloud provider, un neocloud GPU ou un acteur HPC ;

  • Kubernetes et orchestration GPU (GPU Operator, MIG, Slurm) ;

  • Infrastructure as code ;

  • Stockage haute performance ;

  • Stack d’inférence (vLLM, SGLang) ;

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

 

Des choix à prendre, pas à subir : vous décidez de l’architecture d’un matériel de toute dernière génération.

Un vrai rôle de direction : rattaché au CEO, avec un impact direct sur la trajectoire et les financements de l’entreprise.

Une fonction à bâtir : process, équipe, sites.

Un cloud souverain français : une alternative européenne aux hyperscalers, avec une équipe resserrée et des décisions rapides.

 

Package et avantages

 

  • 100 à 120 k€ brut annuel fixe

  • BSPCE

  • Télétravail flexible, deux jours de présence à Lyon toutes les deux semaines (défrayés). Des déplacements réguliers en data center à Paris et chez les fournisseurs sont à prévoir.

  • Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

 

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

title: Computer Vision Engineer - Tracker
original_description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

 

About the Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer in the Computer Vision Tracker team, you will join us at a very early stage, giving you a unique opportunity to heavily influence the technical direction of the team. Operating out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will focus on creating a global 3D Object Tracking pipeline, at the intersection between the Computer Vision, Sensor Fusion and GNC teams.

 

Responsibilities

  • Computer Vision Algorithm Development: Research and implement state-of-the-art Computer Vision approaches to Object Tracking in multiple modalities and scenarios, combining classical and geometrical methods with AI detection models developed in-house.

  • Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuse data from multiple sensors (Cameras, IMU, Radar, etc.) to provide high-precision target estimation and robust tracking through challenging conditions.

  • Edge Optimization for Low-Compute Deployment: Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC, Sensor Fusion, and AI teams to integrate your tracking pipelines into a seamless, production-ready environment.

  • Research & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in computer vision, tracking algorithms, and sensor fusion to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the product.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by managing or mentoring junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Mathematics).

  • Embedded Algorithmic Expertise: Proven track record in the research, development, and productization of Computer Vision & Sensor-Fusion algorithms in hardware-constrained environments.

  • Technical Competence: Strong proficiency in C++ and Python for real-time systems. Experience with optimizing code for edge deployment.

 

Nice to have

  • Highly structured, analytical, task-aligned, and research-oriented.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to effectively translate and present complex algorithmic trade-offs to downstream users and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality toward building foundational team infrastructure.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

 

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Research Engineer - Search and Services
original_description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are seeking a talented and experienced Research Engineer to join our newly forming Search and Services Platform team within Research Platform. You will build and operate the large-scale search and services that our models rely on as tools — from self-hosted, web-scale, search indexes to knowledge graphs and databases served through MCP. You will work closely with researchers and with the pretraining data, sandbox and data platform teams to make these services reliable, scalable and fast, on infrastructure measured in hundreds of terabytes of NVMe storage and thousands of CPU cores to support both data generation and critical training runs.

What you will do

As a Research Engineer on the Search and Services team, your responsibilities will include (but may not be limited to):

  • Designing, building and operating large-scale search infrastructure: self-hosted Vespa clusters indexing web-scale corpora, managed indexes for smaller corpora, and vendor search endpoints.

  • Self-hosting and maintaining a wide range of structured data sources — knowledge graphs (Wikidata, UniProt, Materials Project), scholarly data (OpenAlex, OpenAIRE), statistical databases (Eurostat, World Bank, IMF, OECD), open data portals and more.

  • Designing interfaces and tools to expose to the models and agents to use the services in different ways (direct YQL or SPARQL queries, or more refined and constrained MCPs to mimic external services) to support data generation and agentic training.

  • Building the data pipelines that ingest, index and serve massive datasets, including indexing our own pretraining corpora for exploration, deduplication and eval-leakage checks.

  • Building strong relationships with researchers and adjacent teams (pretraining data,, sandbox, data platform), understanding their workflows and enabling them to achieve more by leveraging your expertise.

  • Communicating and producing documentation or any content that will help teams make the most of the services you'll build.

About you

  • 5+ years of successful experience in search engineering, data infrastructure, or a similar SRE / platform role.

  • Proficiency in software development (Python, Go...) and programming best practices.

  • Hands-on experience with large-scale search or data systems (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, ClickHouse or similar).

  • Exposure to site reliability engineering: root cause analysis, in-production troubleshooting, on-call rotations...)

  • Exposure to infrastructure management: containerization, orchestration (Kubernetes), infra-as-code, monitoring, logging, alerting, observability...).

  • Experience designing and operating data pipelines that address large amounts of data.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills (ability to contextualizing, gauging risks and getting buy-in for high stakes and impactful solutions).

  • Ownership, high agency and constantly seeking to learn and improving things for others.

  • Autonomous, self-driven and able to work well in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Low ego and team spirit mindset.

  • Your application will be all the more interesting if you also have:

  • First-hand Vespa (or equivalent large-scale information retrieval) experience.

  • Experience building or operating MCP servers / tool-serving infrastructure for LLMs.

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, RDF / SPARQL, or large structured databases (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DuckDB...).

  • Experience with large bare-metal infrastructure or HPC environments.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
original_description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python
  • Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets
  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

  • Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

What you'll do
  • Under the supervision of the Business Automation team’s more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.
    •  
    Automation Development:
  • Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes
  • Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods
  • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects
    •  
    Data Integration & Transformation:
  • Support the implementation of data pipelines that integrate data from various sources, including APIs, external databases, and third-party services
  • Assist in transforming raw data into clean and ready-to-use models using SQL and dbt
  • Collaborate on data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives
    •  
    Monitoring and Support:
  • Help implement monitoring for automation workflows and data pipelines
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions
  • Assist in documentation of systems, processes, and workflows
    •  
    Collaboration & Learning:
  • Work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders - as diverse as HR, Sales and Product Engineering - to understand requirements and implement effective solutions
  • Continuously expand knowledge of data engineering and automation best practices
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

    • Who you are

  • Technical skills

    The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role.

  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g. layered or dimensional models)
  • Solid coding skills in Python
  • Understanding of ELT/ETL patterns, pipeline design, and data quality testing
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and CI/CD concepts
  • Practical experience with a public cloud provider and a cloud data warehouse
  • Attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify edge cases
  • Good understanding of AI and LLM principles, along with practical use of AI tools in your work
  • Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and verbal

    • Soft skills

  • Problem-solving mindset with critical thinking about business processes
  • Strong communication abilities - translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and active listening skills for accurately capturing business requirements
  • A natural curiosity, eagerness to learn, and comfort asking questions early rather than staying blocked are an absolute must
  • Bonus points: Basic project management capabilities - tracking tasks, managing timelines, and reporting progress

    • Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt, Airflow, or Terraform
  • Exposure to ingestion and reverse ETL tools
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered pipelines or applications

  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family

  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours

title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
original_description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

title: Senior Product Engineer - iOS/Swift
original_description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 
Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.
 
Mission
 
Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.
 
As an iOS Engineer at Qonto, you will:
 
• Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
• Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.
• Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and spearhead new initiatives.
• Champion quality: Maintain an exceptional level of quality by implementing continuous refactoring and unit testing to consistently enhance the codebase.
 
What you can expect
 
• You'll be building for Europe's fastest-growing business banking market, with 600K+ clients across multiple countries and ambitious expansion plans
• Work in an environment that prioritizes quality, comprehensive code reviews, component approach and continuous refactoring as standard practice
• Contribute to a fully Swift-based app using MVP and Coordinators architecture, with modern CI/CD through GitHub, Firebase, and Bitrise
• Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
 
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
 
Your future team

As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.
 
Our stack & practices

Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.

We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.

Want to know more about our mobile performance indicators? Read this.


About You
 
• iOS Expertise: Proven experience as a Mobile native engineer with strong Swift skills and deep understanding of the iOS ecosystem, SDK, and development lifecycle
• Quality-driven development: Strong commitment to best practices, including unit testing (XCTests, FBSnapshots), Clean code / SOLID principles, and organized workflows
• Problem-solving approach: Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges, with ability to deliver tangible value in a fast-paced environment
• Collaborative spirit: Excellent communication skills, fluent english and experience working effectively in cross-functional teams with both technical and non-technical colleagues
• Growth mindset: Curious and proactive developer who thrives on learning new technologies and contributing to a product serving hundreds of thousands of users
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
original_description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer.

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec, but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

  • Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

  • Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

  • Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

  • Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

  • Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

  • Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

  • Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

  • Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

  • Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

  • Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet. Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT. Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written). Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry. Life at Nabla When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked. If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application. Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.
